modules.module_title: Introduction and Pre requisites for Assembly

pcs.pc_description: Describe the role and responsibilities of a Smartphone Assembly Technician; explain the scope of the smartphone manufacturing industry, key components involved (such as display, battery, motherboard, camera, connectors), and career opportunities in electronics manufacturing and service sectors.

Identify and review assembly instructions, specifications, quality standards, and parts list provided by the concerned authority and verify job requirements by cross-checking product specifications and work instructions from approved sources.
Coordinate with relevant team members for efficient workflow and process execution.
Gather necessary tools/equipment such as screwing machine, compression tools, and consumables in working condition.
Inspect and sort required components (LCD, rear & middle cover, touch panel, etc.) as per work order.
Conduct quality checks on components and raw materials to ensure no physical damage or defects.
Perform stepwise inspection of previous assembly stages to ensure completeness before proceeding.
Confirm that Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA) is tested and validated for further assembly.

modules.module_title: Initial Component Handling and Pre Assembly Steps

pcs.pc_description: Select the appropriate assembly method (manual or machine-based) according to work instructions.
Remove protective films, stickers, and unnecessary packaging from components using approved techniques.
Handle the LCD module in an Electrostatic Discharge (ESD)-safe environment to prevent damage.
Clean components with industry-approved solutions (e.g., isopropyl alcohol) to remove dust and contaminants.
Organize the workspace and ensure compliance with safety standards before proceeding with assembly.

pcs.pc_description: Securely assemble components (LCD, screen connectors, batteries, processors and covers, etc.) following approved procedures.
Attach the Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA) onto the middle cover/case using proper fastening techniques.
Carefully mount and secure the LCD screen onto the PCBA as per specifications.
Apply LCD safety cover tape to protect against dust and contaminants.
Fix small modules such as SIM tray, SD card slot, and micro-connectors in their designated positions.
Assemble rear case components, ensuring proper alignment of camera module, vibrator, and speaker.
Verify that IMEI and serial number markings are accurate as per documentation standards.
Ensure each completed sub-assembly is placed in an Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) tray after assembly.

modules.module_title: Final Fixing Quality Checks and Post Assembly Activities

pcs.pc_description: Attach RF cables, connectors, and antenna as per design requirements.
Securely fix the rear cover with the middle cover and complete remaining connector installations.
Ensure the camera lens is positioned and fixed correctly to maintain optical quality.
Conduct a final alignment check to verify the precise positioning of all parts before sealing.
Continuously monitor the assembly line and identify any potential defects or process inefficiencies.

Confirm that the assembled product adheres to production quality and compliance standards using AI-based alignment tools, and vision inspection systems to ensure proper connectivity of parts like camera modules, motherboards, and sensors.
Store all tools and unused materials in designated storage areas after use.
Submit completed smartphone units to the designated department for further testing or packaging.
Maintain documentation for assembled units, highlighting any deviations or rectifications performed.
